checks.summary: The current production chain freezes workspace, file, URI, language, document revision, provider generation and project-scope identity before asynchronous fetch/resolve. CodeWorkspaceTab force-syncs the live buffer, revalidates the token around provider IPC, and rejects provider/session changes. CodeMirrorHost mounts the real LSP source and keeps completion, snippet and resolve-gate acceptance local to the editor. lspCompletion validates primary/additional ranges, combines primary edit, imports and parsed snippet text in one dispatch with one input.complete history event, and preserves selection-only snippet navigation. Timeout, failure, unavailable, cancelled, stale, policy-change and overlap outcomes remain explicit no-op or explicit-choice paths; they do not silently commit old text.
